mapper.sql: select m.member_id, m.member_no, m.name, m.gender, m.student_no, m.phone, m.college, m.major, m.class_name, m.grade, m.cohort, m.dept_id, d.dept_name, m.position, m.status, m.source, m.join_date, m.leave_date, m.email, m.wechat, m.qq, m.skills, m.intro, m.obey_adjust, m.photo_url, m.card_url, m.user_id, m.apply_id, m.remark, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, u.status as account_status, u.login_date as last_login_time from oa_member m left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = m.dept_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = m.user_id and u.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into oa_member ( member_no, name, gender, student_no, phone, college, major, class_name, grade, cohort, dept_id, position, status, source, join_date, leave_date, email, wechat, qq, skills, intro, obey_adjust, photo_url, card_url, user_id, apply_id, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{memberNo}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{studentNo}, #{phone}, #{college}, #{major}, #{className}, #{grade}, #{cohort}, #{deptId}, #{position}, #{status}, #{source}, #{joinDate}, #{leaveDate}, #{email}, #{wechat}, #{qq}, #{skills}, #{intro}, #{obeyAdjust}, #{photoUrl}, #{cardUrl}, #{userId}, #{applyId}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update oa_member set user_id = #{userId}, update_time = sysdate() where member_id = #{memberId}
update oa_member set wechat = #{wechat}, qq = #{qq}, email = #{email}, skills = #{skills}, intro = #{intro}, photo_url = #{photoUrl}, update_time = sysdate() where member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: select max(cast(substring(member_no, 7) as signed)) from oa_member where member_no like concat('M', #{year}, '-%')

select count(*) from oa_member m left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = m.dept_id
m.status in ('1', '2') and m.leave_date is not null and date_format(m.leave_date, '%Y%m') = date_format(sysdate(), '%Y%m') and m.dept_id = #{deptId} ${params.dataScope}
select dept_id as deptId, count(*) as memberCount from oa_member where status = '0' and dept_id is not null group by dept_id
select count(*) from oa_member where user_id = #{userId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and status = '0'
